title: Agreement between artificial intelligence and expert evaluation in assessing the quality of asthma health education videos on YouTube and Bilibili: cross-sectional study

live_model.evidence: "All evaluations were performed using GPT-4 (gpt-4-turbo) between February 10 to February 25, 2026...temperature parameter was set to 0, top-p to 1.0..."; Table 2 "GQS Spearman rho=0.55, p<0.001".

prompt.location: "The complete prompt template is provided in Supplementary Additional File 5" (named released supplementary file, not embedded in main text)
prompt.note: Prompt instructs GPT-4 to score GQS, mDISCERN and PEMAT using each instrument's original scoring rules.

claim.location: Table 2, AI vs. expert rating agreement, GQS row (200 asthma health-education videos, Sec Results)

data.source: 200 publicly available asthma health-education videos from YouTube and Bilibili

notes: The same GPT-4 calls also produce mDISCERN (rho=0.49) and PEMAT understandability/actionability scores (Fig. 1B), all equally reproducible alternates. Human inter-rater agreement (Table 1, ICC ~0.32-0.34) is notably lower than the AI-expert correlation, which is itself an interesting angle if reproduced.
